Subject: New vendor setup — Redwood Inference (PO / payment terms)

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough on Monday. Procurement here needs a couple of items to complete our vendor activation: the vendor onboarding form, W9, and confirmation of how POs will be routed. Two things we need to lock down before finance issues the first PO:

- Preferred payment term (Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60) your team accepts for standard SaaS consumption.
- Whether Redwood offers any short-pay early-pay discount (e.g., 1–2% for payment within 10–15 days).

Our standard is Net 45 for new vendors, but we can consider Net 30 if the supplier requires. Either way, we need to capture the exact remit address and AP contact for PO attachments.

I've attached a copy of our procurement checklist for reference (not attached here in this thread). Can you confirm: 1) what term you prefer, 2) PO invoicing email or portal, and 3) remit details? Also attaching the initial SOW (PDF) for reference — will Redwood need a separate billing contact?

Appreciate a quick reply so we can aim for PO issuance the week of Sep 20.

Best,
Samantha Liao

Samantha — great to hear from you and thanks for the checklist. Forwarding to our AP lead (Laura) and AM (Priyom) to confirm the logistics. Quick answers up front:

- Default net term we typically accept for new customers is Net 45.
- We can offer an early-pay discount pilot (1.5% for payment within 15 days) for the first three months on the initial contract — subject to finance approval.
- Invoices should be routed to invoices@redwood.ai or uploaded via our vendor portal (link below). For POs, please include PO number in the invoice subject line.
- Remit address: Redwood Inference, 420 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105 (for checks); ACH details available on signed vendor form.

Laura — could you confirm whether the 1.5% early-pay pilot is doable from an AP policy perspective and whether any additional onboarding paperwork is needed? Priyom, FYI on the discount pilot and timing (we're aiming for PO week of Sep 20).

Thanks,
Markus Klein

Hi Samantha / Markus,

Thanks — I reviewed this with Finance. Operational details below so procurement can complete onboarding:

Required items to activate vendor record:
- Completed RI vendor onboarding form (attached): includes ACH info, tax classification, and remittance instructions.
- Signed W-9 (we can accept scanned PDF).
- Vendor contact (billing@orchardanalytics.com) and preferred invoice format (PDF with PO in subject).

Payment term options:
- Standard: Net 45 (default for new accounts).
- Option: Net 30 if requested and approved by Revenue Ops (we reserve Net 30 for strategic partners).
- Early-pay: We are prepared to pilot a 1.5% discount for payments made within 15 days for the first 90 days after go-live. Finance requires a signed amendment that captures the early-pay percentage and the start/end dates.

PO routing and invoice processing:
- Please include the PO number in the email subject and send invoices to invoices@redwood.ai.
- If Orchard prefers EDI/portal submission, we can provision a vendor portal login within 3 business days after vendor record creation.

Next steps for Orchard procurement:
1) Return the completed RI_vendor_onboarding_form_v3.xlsx with ACH and billing contact.
2) Attach signed W-9.
3) Confirm whether you accept Net 45 or request Net 30.
4) If you want the early-pay pilot, confirm acceptance of 1.5% for 15-day settlement and sign the short amendment (I can send a one-page addendum).

I'll prepare the addendum draft once you confirm. If everything arrives by Sep 22, we can issue the PO on Sep 24.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
